old_caption: The video begins with a high-angle view looking down into a large, curved concrete structure, likely a dam or reservoir. A metal walkway extends from the left side, curving around the structure. The center of the visible area contains a patch of gravel and sparse vegetation, with a square, patterned concrete slab. A small red object is visible near the right edge of the structure. The camera remains mostly static, with slight motion blur suggesting a slow drift or adjustment, maintaining the high-angle perspective throughout the clip. The surrounding environment includes rocky cliffs and greenery at the top edges of the frame.
original_wisa_caption: The video begins with a close-up shot of a person's hands holding a Spalding TF-150 basketball. The individual is wearing a wristwatch on their left hand, which is adorned with a black sleeve. The background reveals a scenic view of a dam with a metal walkway extending over it, surrounded by lush greenery and rocky cliffs. The camera then pans upward, transitioning from the close-up of the basketball to an aerial view of the dam. The aerial perspective showcases the expansive structure of the dam, its concrete walls, and the surrounding natural landscape. The camera continues to pan around the dam, providing a comprehensive view of its surroundings, including the metal walkway and the dense vegetation. The video concludes with a wide-angle shot of the dam, emphasizing its grandeur and the serene environment it is nestled in.
caption: An aerial, top-down view looks into a large concrete basin resembling a dam spillway. A metal truss bridge spans the left side, and a square concrete pad sits in grass and gravel at the center. A curved concrete wall sweeps along the right, and a small red spherical object rests against its inner face. The camera view is tilted diagonally at first, then rotates and levels toward a direct overhead orientation, shifting the bridge and pad within the frame while keeping them visible. As the perspective settles, the red object travels steadily along the inner curve of the wall, moving from the lower-central area toward the right side of the frame. The surrounding rock walls and patches of vegetation remain fixed in the background throughout. The motion of the red sphere continues along the wall's curve without stopping within the visible portion of the clip.
